title: Intersecting an affine open with a line-bundle nonvanishing locus is affine
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M)$ a global section, and $U\subseteq Y$ an affine open. Then $U\cap Y_s$ (the nonvanishing locus $Y_s$ as in [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]) is affine. The same holds for a section of any positive tensor power of $\mathcal M$.

proof.text: Restrict the affine open U and the invertible module M to the affine scheme U. Writing U=Spec(R), the affine dictionary gives N=Gamma(U,M) as a finite projective R-module of rank 1, identifies M|_U with the sheaf tilde(N), and identifies U intersect Y_s with the set of primes p for which s is not in pN.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PV proof, first paragraph: translation to the algebra problem

proof.text: By [lem-sc-affine-cap-section-open-algebra] applied to R, N, s, the set V={p : s not in pN} is affine, hence U cap Y_s is affine.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PV proof, construction and identification of the affine algebra

proof.text: Let n>=1 and t a global section of M^{tensor n}. M^{tensor n} is an invertible O_Y-module [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]; applying the first clause to M^{tensor n} and t gives that U cap Y_t is affine.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PV and the positive tensor-power clause

lean.statement: theorem affine_cap_section_open (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (s : M.val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : (∃ V : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ ∀ x : X, x ∈ V ↔ x ∈ U ∧ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial) s ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk M.val.presheaf x))) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ t : (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤), ∃ V : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen V ∧ ∀ x : X, x ∈ V ↔ x ∈ U ∧ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial) t ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf x)))
